preconditions.description: The length of string X must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of string Y must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() for c in X) and all(c.isalpha() for c in Y)
preconditions.description: Both strings X and Y must consist only of alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(c.upper() in Y for c in X if c.islower()) and all(c in Y for c in X if c.isupper()) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if all lowercase letters in X can be converted to uppercase and match Y, and all uppercase letters in X match Y; otherwise, it returns 0.
